items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: Fascio had a place down there called Fascio's Supper Club - and, uh, I opened - we had Red Richards and Charlie Smith... so it would be three colored guys and myself in this thing

ctx.x: Anyway, we got there and opened up and, of course, when Fascio took a look at the band and he

took me over to the side and he said - I didn't know you had any colored guys in the band -- I said, well, what's the difference? He said, well, Jesus, the colored people don't work together with white down here and I said - well, Christ, this is a hell of a time to tell me. I said, the booking office should have told me. He said, well, anyway, we'll do it without you. Well, the first couple of days he got bomb threats and people were going to burn the place down and such things as that. And, I couldn't find a…
